payload.text: The Claude Usage PR, upstream to richhickson/claudecodeusage, on hv's word (decision 12): Claude Usage 1.18 names each Keychain item once per run and keeps history per item, so after a switch its names are stale and its history mixes accounts. ic builds the fix in hv's fork (/Users/matts/Devel/forks/claudecodeusage) on a branch from upstream's v1.18, with tests and a Desk run, and drafts the PR text in simple ASD-STE100 bullets. vc reads the change, puts the text to hv, and nothing is pushed or opened until hv says so.
